description: An expander that shifts and shuffles the sequence of the JP sequencer it is placed against, under button or trigger control; it goes immediately to the right of that sequencer

params.text: Chooses whether a shift moves every note block or only the blocks inside the current sequence length
Moves the note blocks of the sequence one position to the left
Moves the note blocks of the sequence one position to the right
Moves every note in the sequence to the next note in the current note pool
Moves every note in the sequence down to the next note in the current note pool
Gives each column of note blocks a chance of swapping places with another column
Gives each column of note blocks a chance of having its rows shuffled
Sets the chance that a column is swapped or shuffled, from none to every column

inputs.text: Moves the note blocks one position to the left when triggered; how far each volt moves them is set on the menu
Moves the note blocks one position to the right when triggered; how far each volt moves them is set on the menu
Moves every note down to the next note in the note pool when triggered; how far each volt moves them is set on the menu
Moves every note to the next note in the note pool when triggered; how far each volt moves them is set on the menu
Shuffles the columns of note blocks when the voltage rises past 2V, with the chance set by the strength knob
Shuffles the rows within each column when the voltage rises past 2V, with the chance set by the strength knob

notes: this module does nothing on its own: place it directly to the right of a Three Track, Star Matrix Jr, Improv Jr or Evo Seq, with no module in between
patching a sequencer's end-of-cycle output into one of these inputs applies that change once a cycle
a shift mode marked Uni reads a negative voltage as zero, and one marked Bi steps in the opposite direction on it
menu: Shift Left Mode: Always 1 (at 2V+), 1 / Volt Uni, 1 / Volt Bi, 1 / 2 Volts Uni, 1 / 2 Volts Bi, 12 / Volt Uni, 12 / Volt Bi — sets how far one volt on the left shift input moves the sequence
Shift Right Mode: Always 1 (at 2V+), 1 / Volt Uni, 1 / Volt Bi, 1 / 2 Volts Uni, 1 / 2 Volts Bi, 12 / Volt Uni, 12 / Volt Bi — sets how far one volt on the right shift input moves the sequence
Shift Up Mode: Always 1 (at 2V+), 1 / Volt Uni, 1 / Volt Bi, 1 / 2 Volts Uni, 1 / 2 Volts Bi, 12 / Volt Uni, 12 / Volt Bi — sets how far one volt on the up input moves the notes
Shift Down Mode: Always 1 (at 2V+), 1 / Volt Uni, 1 / Volt Bi, 1 / 2 Volts Uni, 1 / 2 Volts Bi, 12 / Volt Uni, 12 / Volt Bi — sets how far one volt on the down input moves the notes

inputs.4:
unipolar · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
